note: Frima (Treasure) (slug frima — the TREASURE variant; never the bare base Frima, P0 disambiguation) — Tetra Iron SR Supporter, Burst I, 20s CD, ammo 6, reloadFrames 111, chargeFrames 60, normalMult 65.95, chargeMultiplier 250, critRate 15 / critDamage 150. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02. VALUE SOURCE: the favorite-item prose (characters.frima.skills) is the SSOT (DECISIONS 2026-07-17 roster-wide treasure ruling); the datamine skill1/skill2 detail tables carry the UNTREASURED base kit and DISAGREE (base S1 = 'after 4 normal attacks, DEF ▼15.84%/10s' with no stacking/true damage; base S2/burst have no True Damage lines at all). Her identity is the Wake Up true-damage state: a self status that turns her SR normals true and unlocks the team True Damage ▲ amplification (S2 + burst) that pays off her own true normals and any teammate's true-flavored damage (ada grenades, helm cannon, jill acid…). WAKE UP ≡ the trueNormals weaponSwap window (co-extensive construction — the engine has no self-status channel, eunhwa-tu/asuka-wille precedent; but unlike eunhwa-tu, frima has NO competing burst cannon for the single swap slot, so the swap carries Wake Up exactly). S1-L1 'hitting a target with Full Charge → Sleepy: DEF ▼ 4%, stacks up to 5 time(s) for 10 sec' = shotFired → enemy defPct -4 /10s maxStacks 5 (every SR pull is a full charge; the engine adds +1 stack per application to the cap and refreshes the 10s window — exactly the kit's stacking semantics). The stacks ride the live enemy DEF channel (bossDefNow scales cfg.bossDef, floor 0): max 20% of the scope-lock boss's 140 DEF ≈ 28 ATK ≈ 0.02% at scope, live at the web raid DEF defaults; NOT damageTakenPct (a different bucket that would over-credit a ~20% team vuln the kit does not deliver — viper/phantom/guilty/marciana precedent). S1-L2 'landing 6 Full Charge attacks on a target with max stacks of Sleepy → self: normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec' = chargeCounter {count:6, countInFb:6} → self weaponSwap {damagePct:65.95, trueNormals:true, sameWeapon:true, durationSec:10}. sameWeapon is the engine's 'the gun is not replaced' marker — it withholds the magazine refill at both ends of the window, which is what a flavor change should do (trueNormals alone is only the damage flavor). damagePct 65.95 = her own normal multiplier (datamine), so swap shots deal EXACTLY her normal FC damage (baseMult swap path, sim.ts `firePull()`, the weaponSwap `damagePct` base-multiplier path; the base chargeMultiplier 250 still applies because the swap sets no chargeMultPct, sim.ts `dealDamage()`, the `chargeMultPct` fallback chain) — only the flavor changes, exactly as the kit says. The 'max stacks of Sleepy' precondition is satisfied by construction: Sleepy stacks once per FC hit (S1-L1), so 5 FCs bring max stacks and the 6-FC count lands on a max-stack target (the 10s stack duration outlasts her ~7.85s FC cycle — stacks never lapse mid-cycle). countInFb:6 is EXPLICIT because the chargeCounter default is countInFb ?? 1 within 10s of the owner's OWN burst cast (the SBS lowered-threshold semantics, sim.ts `firePull()`, the `chargeCounter` phase/charge counters); omitting it would fire Wake Up on every FC for 10s after each of her bursts — wrong in principle, though damage-neutral at steady state (the ~7.85s re-trigger cycle < the 10s duration ⇒ ~100% uptime either way; not behaviour-pinnable, see unit-test header). Wake Up uptime is near-permanent after the ~7.85s ramp (first onset on the 6th FC ≈ t=7.9s). S2-L2 'attacking with Full Charge, when in Wake Up status → all allies: True Damage ▲28.16% for 5 sec' = shotFired + swapGate:'swapped' → allies trueDamagePct 28.16 / 5s. shotFired == 'attacking with Full Charge' for an SR (every pull is a full charge; the swap inherits base chargeFrames so swap shots stay charged — helm/liberalio precedent), and shotFired routes through applyBlock so the swapGate (the Wake Up gate) is enforced (chargeCounter would bypass it, vesti-tu finding). allies INCLUDES self (no 'except self' in the kit text) — her own true normals consume this buff. Burst-L3 'when in Wake Up status → all allies: True Damage ▲49.97% for 10 sec' = burstCast + swapGate:'swapped' → allies trueDamagePct 49.97 / 10s; stacks additively with the S2-L2 instance while both are live (distinct buff keys). At steady state every burst cast lands inside the Wake Up window (first cast ≈ t=13-20s, well after the t≈7.9s onset), so the gate is near-damage-neutral there — it matters for casts during the opening ramp or a lapsed window; the unit test pins it swap-keyed via the compound no-Wake-Up counterfactual. BURST-L1 '10 highest-final-DEF enemies: 101.66% of final ATK as damage' = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 101.66, PLAIN flavor (the kit says 'as damage', not 'as true damage' — a true-flavored nuke would dip into her live trueDamagePct stack; the unit test discriminates). The 10-highest-final-DEF targeting collapses to the single boss. Its 'DEF ▼ 9.86% for 10 sec' rider rides the SAME block AFTER the flatDamage (kit-order effects — the cast's own nuke resolves before the fresh shave, novel precedent): defPct -9.86 /10s on the enemy DEF channel, ~0.01% at the scope-lock 140-DEF basis, live at web raid DEF defaults; no stacking clause, and the 20s CD > 10s window means no overlap. B1 cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window → never takes the +50% major (verified helm precedent; pinned in the unit test). trueDamagePct is flavor-gated (sim.ts `dealDamage()`, `opts.trueFlavor`): both team buffs pay ONLY on true-flavored hits — inert on teammates dealing no true damage. Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5, S5/S6 claude-opus-5, S7 kimi-code/k3. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02.
caveats: ⚑ Wake Up trigger proxy (low): the kit gates the 6-FC count on the target being at MAX Sleepy stacks; the sim counts every full charge (chargeCounter:6) because there is no 'target at N stacks' block-gate primitive (the Sleepy defPct stacks themselves ARE encoded on the enemy DEF channel — only the max-stack PRECONDITION is proxied). Faithful where it matters: stacks accrue 1/FC hit and max at 5, so the 6th FC always lands on a max-stack target while stacks hold; the proxy would over-fire ONLY if Sleepy stacks lapsed mid-count (a >10s firing pause — boss transitions/downtime, unmodeled in the continuous scope-lock fight). Estimate: damage-neutral at scope (near-permanent uptime either way). Recipe: a 'target at N stacks' block gate reading the live stack count would enact the precondition exactly; popup-read Wake Up icon uptime in a frima focus recording.

⚑ Engine artifact (low): same-weapon flavor swaps skip the SR bolt-recovery cycle (sim.ts's bolt-recovery step, `SR_BOLT_RECOVERY_FRAMES`, the chisato/takina exemption), so frima's shots cycle at 60f (1.0s) during Wake Up vs 82f (1.37s) outside it — her true window fires ~27% faster than her base cadence. Pre-existing engine behavior for every swap state (the rule is keyed on `!u.swap`), not an encoding choice here; it slightly over-represents her true-window shot count. Recipe: extend the bolt-recovery rule to flavor swaps (engine-core), then re-grade.

⚑ countInFb:6 is a faithfulness detail that is damage-neutral in every fixture (steady-state Wake Up uptime is ~100% regardless, since the re-trigger cycle < duration); it is set to keep the '6 Full Charges' threshold honest within 10s of her own burst cast (the engine's chargeCounter defaults countInFb to 1 there — the SBS semantics). Not behaviour-pinnable; documented, not fudged.
